mapper.insert: insert into jsh_project (name, category_id, hourly_rate, default_hours, total_price, remark, enabled, create_time, update_time, delete_flag) values (#{name}, #{categoryId}, #{hourlyRate}, #{defaultHours}, #{totalPrice}, #{remark}, #{enabled}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, '0')
mapper.update: update jsh_project set name = #{name}, category_id = #{categoryId}, hourly_rate = #{hourlyRate}, default_hours = #{defaultHours}, total_price = #{totalPrice}, remark = #{remark}, enabled = #{enabled}, update_time = #{updateTime} where id = #{id} and tenant_id = #{tenantId} and ifnull(delete_flag,'0') !='1'
mapper.select: select p.*, pc.name as category_name from jsh_project p left join jsh_project_category pc on p.category_id = pc.id where p.id = #{id} and ifnull(p.delete_flag,'0') !='1'

select p.*, pc.name as category_name from jsh_project p left join jsh_project_category pc on p.category_id = pc.id where p.category_id = #{categoryId} and ifnull(p.delete_flag,'0') !='1' order by p.id desc
